title: Shibuya Station
exportLabel: Molen original mapped Shibuya JR and Ginza station exterior source
visualBrief: Complete source model of the mapped above-ground Shibuya JR/Ginza passenger-station exterior: both whole mapped JR island platforms and longitudinal canopy families, the Hachiko-side entrance frontage, central raised concourse, new south hall and south platform covers, the full elevated Ginza terminal with its characteristic white M-section roof/ribs, the mapped east pedestrian deck, west curved connecting passage and small station service block. Preserve independent Shibuya Scramble Square, Hikarie, Stream, Fukuras, Sakura Stage, Mark City/Keio host buildings, surrounding property, streets and rail network. Underground Tokyu/metro concourses and the Keio terminal inside its independent Mark City host have no invented separate above-ground building. Current unfinished redevelopment is not replaced by an imagined completed future complex. No trains, people, brands, adverts, lettering, ticket interfaces or navigable railway interiors.
heightPolicy: Current standard PMTiles retain exact mapped station/terminal footprints and platform polygons. Ordinary 2026 aerial and builder photographs resolve the station frame, surrounding separate towers, concrete entry, white M-section Ginza roof and repeated ribs. Main low station roof11m, Ginza roof19m, east deck13.7m, south hall23.5m and service3.9m follow native height tags; JR platform floor6.2m, raised concourse floor12m and its roof18m, Ginza floor12m and west passage floor6.5m are explicit medium-fi estimates. Hidden JR canopy sections, facade bays, intermediate station levels, live construction inventory and exact platform/road clearances remain approximate. Four illustrative platform stair flights connect the central/south raised halls to the actual platform polygons. Their exact hidden layout is not a surveyed floor plan. Clear roof slots are built around each flight. All station levels are fixed to one common standard field datum 34.911286m at [-65,20]; the unmodified urban field is retained even where roof/vegetation returns conflict with actual railway levels.
nativeAxes: +X SSE along JR tracks toward Ebisu; -X NNW toward Harajuku; +Z WSW toward Hachiko plaza/Mark City; -Z ENE toward Scramble Square/Hikarie and the elevated Ginza terminal; +Y up.

Ordinary recent aerial, street and builder photographs plus standard PMTiles; no bespoke survey. Mapped outlines and height tags are retained. Intermediate floors, hidden facade inventory, roof sections, JR access layout and changing redevelopment details are medium-fi estimates. Exact railway/road clearances, present construction state and accessible thresholds are unverified. Standard urban terrain may intersect raised platforms/frontages and must remain an explicit pending placement issue if observed. Physical laptop/phone/dense-city timing and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured.

Five existing 256px shared graphs: concrete_plain, stone_granite, metal_standing_seam, metal_painted and window_grid. Six merged near semantic groups and one far palette group; metric UVs and linear colours. No embedded/private images. Actual glazing alone uses window_grid. Roofs, concrete, opaque metal panels and pale painted ribs retain their proper shared slots. All four tiers retain both whole JR platform polygons, the Ginza M-roof, mapped halls/passages and complete west connecting link. Near tiers add rib/column families, glazing recesses, facade frames, platform edge bands and two-sided stair/deck railings. Stair roof slots follow the explicitly estimated source flights. No claimed surveyed floor plan.

references.observed: March 2026 aerial inspected: JR longitudinal station lies between independent Scramble Square tower and western Hachiko plaza; elevated Ginza line crosses east/west beside the tower, with visible pale roof. Major station redevelopment remains unfinished. Preserve commercial towers, plazas, independent street buildings and highways; do not fabricate finished future central/west tower masses.
Ordinary street entry photo: exposed concrete beam with broad curved haunches/columns, recessed open passage and yellow accent. Lettering, people, signage and ticket interfaces omitted.

Ordinary construction photo: white repeated M-section ribs with central valley and raised shoulders; grey roof/soffit between ribs. Roof and rib profile informs geometry; workers, cranes and temporary rail kit omitted.
Builder engineering illustration inspected for roof-section continuity only; not treated as a current photograph or a surveyed floor plan. No construction machines copied.

Ordinary 2024 south-passage exterior photo inspected: white/grey covered platform roofs and metal frames below raised glazed passage; light grey cladding, dark glazing and temporary construction enclosure. Exact hidden JR facades/platform access arrangement is estimated. No copied scaffolding, billboards, people, brands or ticket interfaces.
